introduction.situation: Strategy studies how opposing parties contend through organised force.
introduction.complication: The knowledge is scattered across military, naval, weapons and detection headings that obscure which feature of the contest each one explains.
introduction.question: How is everything in strategy divided?
introduction.answer: Strategy is divided by the feature of the strategic situation that a claim explains, namely the actors who contend, the game they play, the coercion they apply, the conduct of their operations, and the information each side holds.

governing_thought: Strategy is divided by the feature of the strategic situation that a claim explains, namely the actors who contend, the game they play, the coercion they apply, the conduct of their operations, and the information each side holds.

key_line.mece_dimension: the feature of the strategic situation that the claim explains
key_line.rank_note: The pillars run from who contends, to the setting of the contest, to the force applied, to how it is carried out, to what each side knows.

points.statement: Actors are the forces, organisations and personnel that contend in a strategic situation, and their administration and organisation explain who contends.
points.name: Actors are the forces, organisations and personnel that contend in a strategic situation, and their administration and organisation explain who contends.

support.rank_note: From general forces to the specific land and naval services.

points.statement: Military forces and their organisation and administration explain how armed actors are constituted and governed.
points.name: Military forces and their organisation and administration explain how armed actors are constituted and governed.

support.rank_note: From forces in general to their administration.

points.statement: Naval and marine personnel are the human actors who crew and serve in naval forces.
points.name: Naval and marine personnel are the human actors who crew and serve in naval forces.

support.rank_note: From seamen to marines.

points.title: Actors

points.statement: The game is the strategic setting of conflict, defence and operational planning that gives the contest its structure.
points.name: The game is the strategic setting of conflict, defence and operational planning that gives the contest its structure.

support.rank_note: From the scholarly study of conflict to defence and operational frameworks.

points.statement: Conflict and defence research fields are scholarly disciplines that study war, civil conflict and defence as features of the strategic situation.
points.name: Conflict and defence research fields are scholarly disciplines that study war, civil conflict and defence as features of the strategic situation.

support.rank_note: Parallel academic fields; no ranking implied.

points.statement: Defense and operations frameworks are the strategic-level arrangements for protecting a population and for planning and conducting military action.
points.name: Defense and operations frameworks are the strategic-level arrangements for protecting a population and for planning and conducting military action.

support.rank_note: Ordered from civil protection through defense systems to operational strategy and tactics.

points.title: The game

points.statement: Coercion is the destructive force that actors apply through weapons, munitions and their physical effects.
points.name: Coercion is the destructive force that actors apply through weapons, munitions and their physical effects.

support.rank_note: From the weapons themselves, to the platforms that carry them, to the launching and physics of their effects.

points.statement: Weapon technologies and munitions are the kinds of armament that deliver destructive force against targets.
points.name: Weapon technologies and munitions are the kinds of armament that deliver destructive force against targets.

support.rank_note: From strategic weapon classes to airborne munitions and naval ordnance.

points.statement: Weapons technologies are classes of armament whose destructive capability shapes the strategic balance between states.
points.name: Weapons technologies are classes of armament whose destructive capability shapes the strategic balance between states.

support.rank_note: Parallel weapon types; no ranking implied.

points.statement: Guided missiles, rockets, and aerial bombs are distinct kinds of airborne munitions that deliver explosive force against targets.
points.name: Guided missiles, rockets, and aerial bombs are distinct kinds of airborne munitions that deliver explosive force against targets.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure of the delivery mechanism: guided propulsion, unguided propulsion, unpowered drop.

points.statement: Combat vehicles, armor, guns and fire control are the land and bombing platforms that bring firepower to bear.
points.name: Combat vehicles, armor, guns and fire control are the land and bombing platforms that bring firepower to bear.

support.rank_note: From vehicles and armor to guns and fire control.

points.statement: Missile technology and explosive and ballistic science explain how coercive force is launched, travels and detonates.
points.name: Missile technology and explosive and ballistic science explain how coercive force is launched, travels and detonates.

support.rank_note: From launching to trajectories, warheads, reentry and the physics of explosions.

points.statement: Guided Missile Launching and Basing Support
points.name: Guided Missile Launching and Basing Support

points.statement: Guided Missile Trajectories, Accuracy and Ballistics
points.name: Guided Missile Trajectories, Accuracy and Ballistics

points.statement: Explosive effects and ballistic science are the physical phenomena and materials that explain how munitions detonate and travel.
points.name: Explosive effects and ballistic science are the physical phenomena and materials that explain how munitions detonate and travel.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure from the explosive materials to the underwater application, the explosion phenomenon, and ballistics.

points.title: Coercion

points.statement: Conduct is the way actors carry out operations through service branches, supply, maintenance and engineering.
points.name: Conduct is the way actors carry out operations through service branches, supply, maintenance and engineering.

support.rank_note: From land branches to supply and naval support services.

points.statement: Land combat branches and engineering are the arms through which armies conduct operations.
points.name: Land combat branches and engineering are the arms through which armies conduct operations.

support.rank_note: From infantry and cavalry to artillery and engineering.

points.statement: Logistics, maintenance and support services sustain forces so that operations can continue.
points.name: Logistics, maintenance and support services sustain forces so that operations can continue.

support.rank_note: From supply to maintenance and minor services.

points.title: Conduct

points.statement: Information is what each side senses, locates, learns and denies, through detection, locating, intelligence and countermeasures.
points.name: Information is what each side senses, locates, learns and denies, through detection, locating, intelligence and countermeasures.

support.rank_note: From sensing, to locating, to intelligence and defeating the opponent's sensing.

points.statement: Detection technologies sense targets through sound, light, radio, magnetic and seismic energy.
points.name: Detection technologies sense targets through sound, light, radio, magnetic and seismic energy.

support.rank_note: From medium-specific to other detection kinds.

points.statement: Medium-specific detection kinds sense targets through sound, light, or radio-wave energy.
points.name: Medium-specific detection kinds sense targets through sound, light, or radio-wave energy.

points.statement: Active and Passive Radar Detection Equipment
points.name: Active and Passive Radar Detection Equipment

support.rank_note: Ordered by sensing medium: acoustic, optical, radar.

points.statement: Magnetic and Electric Field Detection and Detectors
points.name: Magnetic and Electric Field Detection and Detectors

points.statement: Locating, intelligence and countermeasures determine where targets are and exploit or defeat an opponent's detection.
points.name: Locating, intelligence and countermeasures determine where targets are and exploit or defeat an opponent's detection.

support.rank_note: From locating, to gathering intelligence, to defeating the opponent's sensing.

points.statement: Locating functions determine where a target or the own platform is, through bearing, range, position, and guidance.
points.name: Locating functions determine where a target or the own platform is, through bearing, range, position, and guidance.

support.rank_note: Ordered from bearing-only to full range and position fixing and guidance.
